## Context / Problem
Five mixed infrastructure files contain repeated, stale, or misleading comments identified by the audit and revalidated on current `origin/main`. User-facing shell help remains complete; the remediation targets only redundant internal explanation.

## Approach
Edit only standalone comments and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve Terraform, shell, and systemd behavior byte-for-byte. Leave user-facing help complete and correct.

## Scope
- `infra/bootstrap/main.tf` — Preserve local-state, one-time creation of remote-state prerequisites, `prevent_destroy`, and the requirement to migrate main Terraform state before removing the guard or destroying the bucket.
- `infra/github/apply-mirror-lock.sh` — Preserve complete user-facing flags/defaults/authentication/destructive effects; main-and-tag locks, sole deploy-key bypass, preconditions, optional legacy removal, and recovery pointer.
- `infra/github/rollback-mirror-lock.sh` — Preserve complete user-facing help and actual default behavior: delete both lock rulesets and recreate main protection; `--disable` is the non-deleting mode. Preserve snapshot dependency and explicit feature restoration.
- `infra/systemd/rebar-autodeploy.service` — Preserve timer cadence, storm guard, environment overrides, health endpoint, fail-safe nonzero behavior, and `TimeoutStartSec=90` below the two-minute timer period so a hung clone cannot prevent rearming.
- `infra/terraform-github/main.tf` — Preserve main-only lock, deploy-key bypass, no repository resource, bypass-key precondition, imported ownership, and intentional divergence from the shell fallback, which also locks tags. Out-of-scope stale parity prose is tracked by `wolfish-monarchist-maiasaura`.

Consumers are Terraform/GitHub operators, shell users, and systemd.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The leaf commit changes only standalone comments or blank lines in the five declared files; user-facing help remains complete and accurate.
- [x] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked session log authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [x] Every edited comment block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row confirming that redundant, obvious, duplicated, historical, or stale prose was removed while current non-obvious rationale remained.
- [x] Focused mirror-lock/systemd tests, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and repository lint pass; no missing or FAIL semantic-preservation row remains.

## Verification
Run the recorded comment-only guard, focused infrastructure tests, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv lint.
